deviations: compose() takes a loaded Source (open_source: Checkpoint::open, hash_shards, from_config_json, Backing::load) plus ONE module path and ONE index path instead of the plan's single compose(dir, config_text, module, index_path, windows): a plane borrows its backing, so the backing must outlive the call. E-COMPOSE is the same path P0-P7.

run.rs gains pub(crate) visibility on Ctx, canary, read_frozen, cleanup_json, stats_json and write_atomic (no body change) so the compose child reuses the E4 canary and report helpers instead of duplicating them; run.rs is not in the plan's file table. The same-run regression proof covers it.
tests/host_checks.rs: the existing coexistence test (name kept) now admits exactly the Slice 1 path dependencies, as plan 2.1 requires; host_checks.rs is not in the file table.
The committed attempt-3 reference copy lives at fixtures/f020-slice2b-attempt3/child-report.json (hash-pinned regression input, not an evidence record).
C-R-RESOLVE is also used for a QuantizationConfig::from_config_json failure (Slice 1 variant recorded); no fixture probes it.
